question: Indian musician, Pandit Hari Prasad Chaurasia used to play which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flute**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandit Hari Prasad Chaurasia** is renowned for his exceptional skill in playing the flute.
 
• He is a distinguished Indian classical flutist and has made significant contributions to Indian classical music.
